name: Extended Collectibles Tracker (iotrip fix)
description:
Where the remaining stuff at?

Version 1.0.10

A fork of FranklyGD's Extended Collectibles Tracker with the freezes and stale markers fixed. It installs under its own mod id, so it sits alongside the original rather than replacing it - enable only one.

The original: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3244633122

FEATURES

- A marker on the map for every collectible your slugcat can get, each in its own colour: data pearls, blue and gold arena tokens, red safari, green slugcat, white broadcast (Spearmaster only). Empty and pulsing while something is left to do with it, solid once it is not.
- Rooms you have not explored get a glow instead of an exact spot. It pins to the screen edge when the room is off-screen and fades with distance, which makes it a rough compass.
- On the sleep screen, a dot per pearl for each region you have visited. Filled means deciphered; a ring means that pearl is with you - held, swallowed, or on the shelter floor - read or not.
- On the fast travel screen, the region's token and pearl progress at a glance.
- Optional collection tracker on the map: that same grid in the top right while you hold the map, reading your hands and stomach live.
- Optional room names, labelled above each room the map is showing.
- Optional instant map, opening and closing with the button, everything you have explored already shown.
- Map markers, room glow, room names, the collection tracker and instant map each have their own toggle in the Remix options.

FIXES OVER THE ORIGINAL

- The hibernation and death screens freezing, with the slugcat animation still playing - two separate causes.
- The picture freezing while the map is held, the game still running behind it. Vanilla key item markers throw on an item they have no icon for, which abandons the rest of that frame drawing, so Slug Senses and Key Item Tracking can both stay on.
- A pearl collecting a duplicate marker a few times a second, until the pile froze the map.
- Markers for pearls that have no type, pointing at pearls that are not there.
- Markers sitting where a pearl used to be, or a room away from where it is.
- Pearl and token markers going stale until the next hibernation.
- A pearl in your hands as you slept not counting as being in the shelter with you.
- Instant Map revealing itself gradually the first time it opened in a region.

You are welcome to report bugs to me.
